messages:
Alex W: Quick note — I'm starting a refresh of the quickstart for the new 'hello-bento' sample. Main goals: make the auth snippets SDK-first but include curl fallbacks, clarify first deployment (Docker + run locally), and fix console links. I'll open a WIP PR later today. Can @maria handle auth, @jo container, @sam SDK snippets?

Maria G: On it. Which auth pattern do we want to prioritize? SDK automatic auth or explicit bearer examples? I think SDK first + a single curl fallback. Also propose normalizing the env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY across samples.

Sam L: Noted — SDK v7 changed the client param name from `token` -> `apiKey`. I'll update snippets and add a tiny migration note for people on v6. Example I'll add: `const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });`

Jo P: I can do the Docker section. I'll suggest a multi-stage build + non-root runtime user + a simple HEALTHCHECK. Will paste a snippet in the PR.

Alex W: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/719 (WIP). Please leave inline CRs. Also planning to retire the old 'hello-world' label to avoid confusion with legacy guides — use 'hello-bento' everywhere.

Maria G: Quick heads-up: console URL changed earlier this month — project links now go to `/console/projects/<id>` instead of `/projects/<id>`. I'll sweep links in quickstart.md.

Ravi K: Small infra note: Dedicated endpoints will default to `/v1/dedicated` soon; hosted remains `/v1`. Quickstart should default to hosted endpoints and show a short callout for Dedicated customers. Otherwise folks copy the endpoint and hit 404s.

Sam L: I'll add a callout block with both endpoint examples and a short line: "Use hosted unless you have a Dedicated hostname."

Jo P: Dockerfile snippet (for PR comments):
```
FROM node:18-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --production
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
USER 1000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD node dist/healthcheck.js || exit 1
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for docs/pr-719 at 2742218895 — staging build succeeded :white_check_mark:

Alex W: Thanks all. If @sam @maria @jo can get reviews by EOD tomorrow we can merge before next week's onboarding batch. I'll ping #docs-reminders.

Maria G: :thumbsup: Added SDK-first auth example + curl fallback, normalized REDWOOD_API_KEY, and fixed console links. PTAL.

Sam L: Added SDK v7 example and short migration note for v6 -> v7. lgtm pending Jo's final Docker wording.

Jo P: Updated Docker wording, added non-root rationale and HEALTHCHECK explanation. lgtm.

Alex W: Plan: merge tomorrow morning if no objections. Closing thread here unless fallout. Thanks!
